compatibility_findings.finding: A CIPR suite-topology change must not silently perform PYT-G2 runner cutover.
compatibility_findings.effect: Standalone unittest remains required until its separately governed cutover condition is satisfied.

compatibility_findings.finding: pytest-native parallelism/xdist would change process topology, ordering and runner admission semantics beyond PYT-G1 parity proof.
compatibility_findings.effect: Not recommended as the first CIPR-G4 implementation delta.

compatibility_findings.finding: Deterministic required sharding can be designed runner-neutral at first.
compatibility_findings.effect: Each shard can preserve current test content while the aggregate final assurance continues to require the existing PYT-WP1 checks or a separately approved equivalent.

compatibility_findings.finding: Current-main pytest execution is not faster than unittest without parallelism.
compatibility_findings.effect: Runner replacement is not itself a supported performance justification.

phase_1_after_cipr_g4_pass: preserve pytest-unittest-parity and runner-parity exact-head checks
introduce deterministic shard manifest and union-completeness proof without omitting tests
run candidate shard topology in shadow alongside the existing canonical surface
do not remove any legacy required check
recommended_coordination_contract.later_cutover: Any removal/replacement of standalone unittest or admission of a broader pytest-native surface remains governed by PYT-G2 or an explicit superseding operator decision that names both programmes.
